status: FINAL 2026-09-29: A1 release v1.0.1 (tolerance-provenance patch of v1.0.0). Adds hash-pinned provenance for the already-closed delayed-tolerance join (29/330 production, 19/330 strict-tolerance, 18/330 changed labels), revises the tolerance raw-artifact disposition and its checksums, and pins the manuscript-display generators plus the display source manifest. All 74 result/checksum files and the A1 control documents are committed and hash-verified; registries consistent; CI green. Release tag v1.0.1 -- cite the tag (release.url); no commit SHA is pinned in this manifest by design.

canonical_form_notes.prospective_scores: Original manifest records NPZ container hash 3978f8aa7c44716c732d528b6d2e39ebf4c147909ff5cd21e0e2e58b4a96c488, but the public dataset holds six NPY arrays (Kaggle expansion) whose sizes decode exactly to the n=12809 cohort. The six arrays are the canonical public representation. A reconstructed NPZ will carry a NEW hash and must be noted as semantically equivalent, never as matching the old container hash.
canonical_form_notes.merged_triples_size: merged_triples.npz (1817502996 bytes) was written with uncompressed np.savez for read speed; dominant array feats is 500000x11x79 float32 = 1738000000 bytes. Production chunk NPZs are compressed (~481+482 MB). The 116 MB series PKLs are separate diagnostics, not contained in the merged NPZ.
